title: Rest: a pad under the floor of a closed hollow box (the profile's shadow also crosses the top)

steps.comment: the profile's shadow crosses the floor and, across the inside, the top: only the floor counts (journey pass)

expect.note: Closed box 60 x 40 x 20 with 2 mm walls all round: 48000 - 56 x 36 x 16 = 15744. The rest under the floor (plane z -3, profile 20 x 20): a plate 20 x 20 x 2 (z -3..-1) = 800, walls 2 thick round it down to the floor (20 x 20 - 16 x 16) x 1 = 144, the old floor inside the walls taken away 16 x 16 x 2 = 512 (the inside open): +432 = 16176. Before the journey pass the top's inside face (z 18, looking down) was taken for the outer skin and the walls ran up to the top.
